usage: Coriander is used as a herb to add fresh flavor to dishes.
Its leaves are often added just before serving to keep the aroma.
Some people dislike coriander because of its strong taste.
Coriander stems are also edible and used in cooking.
It pairs well with spicy and sour flavors in Cantonese dishes.
